notes.title: EVIE: THE ECHO CONDITION - Next Fest Live Stream
notes.notes:
We will be streaming throughout all of Next Fest to hang out and chat with anyone while we play the demo for Evie: The Echo Condition.  We'd love to chat with anyone who stops by and is interested in the game, or games in general!

Steve Young and Doug Kiklowicz are the two developers on the project, and we'll both be taking turns streaming throughout the week, and if no one is available at the time we'll stream our devlogs instead.  Check out the demo and let us know what you think!

Email:  reboundstudios@yahoo.com
